svg.title: Heartbeat viewport ownership, persisted-poll coherence, and interruption chrome truth scars
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing source-level heartbeat ownership constraints. Persisted poll classification and coherent one-map SharedPreferences reading are wired into the existing Operator Overlay owner. The existing owner now also consumes model-owned interruption summary and detail truth so a pre-contact read wound says refresh blocked instead of contact held. Android runtime, TalkBack behavior, deployment, phone delivery, and P0 recovery remain unproven and untouched.
svg.text: WARM WALL / PERSISTENT SELECTION ≠ PERMANENT OWNER
OWNER SOURCE WIRED • RUNTIME UNPROVEN • TALKBACK UNCLAIMED • PHONE/P0 UNTOUCHED
CAPTURE
● SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED A
Capture anchor + keyboard baseline + viewport offset.
SHOVEL
newer interaction wins
BEFORE RESTORE
● SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED B
selection persists; newer keyboard navigation kills A ticket
EXISTING OWNER / EXPLICIT SCOPE
Stable in-place refresh → mutation may destroy focus = NO. Empty child focus gets no rebuild costume.
Structural or drift fallback rebuild → may destroy focus = YES; root direct-focus scope is checked before restore.
Different heartbeat focus or any non-heartbeat direct focus → stale ticket dies. TalkBack remains separate evidence.
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Source wiring ≠ Android execution. Direct keyboard focus ≠ TalkBack focus.
SOURCE BOUNDS / PARSER = DIRECT TYPED GATE
Oversized direct Candidate → BLOCKED · last-good contact held · motion forbidden · no truncation costume.
ONE MATERIAL ID = ONE OWNER
regnet + REGNET material aliases → REJECTED · no first-wins Button · last-good contact held · no motion.
ROOT PULSE ID / ONE BOUND
parser = direct scene = pre-parser diagnostic · max+1 → REJECTED · attempted ID suppressed · contact held · no motion.
PERSISTED POLL / OWNER SOURCE WIRED
empty before first contact → WAITING · empty after contact → WOUND ONCE · unchanged → NO DECODE / PARSE / UI / SPEECH / MOTION
unexpected projection abort → RETRY · positive timestamp magnitude alone → NO SEMANTIC WORK
COHERENT READ OWNER WIRED • READ FAILURE → BOUNDED WOUND + OLD SNAPSHOT RETAINED + NEXT POLL RETRIES
CHROME TRUTH / EXISTING OWNER WIRED
pre-contact wound → REFRESH BLOCKED · accepted/preserved pulse → CONTACT HELD · summary + detail share one contact truth
Repository source only. No Android execution, phone execution, queue, P0 recovery, deployment, delivery, or acceptance evidence.
